title: liquiditybot — trading desk
description: COMMAND — what is the bot doing right now: equity & P&L, the open book, liveness, exposure by asset, fill mix, and the loss-budget posture.

panels.title: Equity
panels.description: Account equity, marked to market. PAPER account - the bot runs dry_run and places no real order.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Today
panels.description: P&L since midnight, realized plus unrealized.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: This week
panels.description: P&L over the trading week. A capital sweep (savings/reserve skim) can read as a false weekly loss here - the RP-041 family; see the budget_reanchor_week control verb if a drop coincides with a sweep rather than a losing run.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Since capital epoch
panels.description: Equity minus starting_capital, where starting_capital is RE-ANCHORED at each capital-epoch reset (a savings/reserve sweep mints a new epoch) - this is since-the-last-epoch P&L, not a lifetime total, despite the metric's own name (liquiditybot_net_pnl_all_time, kept for compatibility).

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Drawdown
panels.description: Percent below STARTING (capital-epoch) equity, cash+savings basis only - blind to unrealized P&L. NOT peak-to-trough and NOT mark-to-market. The drawdown the catastrophe hard stop actually watches is the MTM peak-to-trough figure on the Problems board ('Drawdown vs the hard stop').

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Equity
panels.description: Equity over the dashboard time range. Gaps wider than 5 min are drawn as gaps, not bridged - a flat line across an outage would be a fiction. Empty means: not in this cycle's status write.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Open positions
panels.description: Count of open positions. A zero here is a flat book; a MISSING series means the status write carried no positions key, or the exporter is down.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Gross exposure
panels.description: Notional at risk as a percent of equity.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Fees paid
panels.description: Cumulative simulated fees. At this account size fees are the binding constraint, so they belong on the front page. Venue-true since cut #8 (era 8-ca55e2ba, 2026-08-28): Kraken Tier-1 40/80 bps on both pricing and booking - the FEE-1 understatement is shipped, not merely a caveat.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Entries
panels.description: Whether the bot may OPEN new positions. Exits are always allowed regardless of this.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Halt
panels.description: Circuit breaker. 'clear' is the healthy state.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the RUNNER last wrote outputs/status.json (gc_pusher.py: now - status['written_at']) - the age of the bot's own write, NOT of the push. If this climbs, every other number on this board is a fossil - read it FIRST. Subsumes the separate Telemetry STALE/fresh tile (merged 2026-08-28): the exporter itself marks the whole batch STALE past 120s, tighter than this tile's own 300s red line.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Runner
panels.description: Is the bot's own loop alive. STOPPED here means every money tile above is a fossil, however healthy it looks.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Kraken feed
panels.description: Kraken websocket. REST means degraded marks, not an outage.

panels.title: Op state
panels.description: Overall operating state. Distinct from the Halt tile: that is the circuit breaker alone, this is the whole posture.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Paper / Live
panels.description: Which mode the bot itself reports. PAPER: dry-run, no real order leaves the bot. LIVE: real money - deliberate red accent so it can never be missed. 'unknown' means the runner wrote a mode this board does not recognize.

defaults.noValue: mode not in this status write - state unknown

panels.title: Open positions
panels.description: One row per open position, joined on symbol. An empty table is AMBIGUOUS and must not be read as a flat book: the same emptiness appears when the runner freezes, because every liquiditybot_position_* series stops being emitted while the positions are still genuinely open (measured 2026-08-15 - 5 open, 0 series). Read the Runner and Data age tiles before concluding anything from an empty table. ERA-8: this book is EXPECTED quiet (derived entry bar 0.8335, conviction entries effectively stopped at true costs) - an empty table now is the strategy's honest position, not a fault; read Runner/Data age to tell that apart from a frozen bot.

panels.title: Fill mix
panels.description: Of all fills since restart, how many were patient maker orders vs paying the spread to cross. Mostly-maker is the cheap, healthy shape at this account size. Total fills = the two slice values summed (the separate 'Fills so far' tile was folded in here 2026-08-28); read them off the legend or hover tooltip.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Profit pools
panels.description: Money skimmed out of the trading float into the savings and reserve pools. It counts in equity but is no longer at risk.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write
